Meet the owner

Owner-operated by Bobby Nojad

Painters Inner West is led personally by Bobby Nojad. For more than twenty years he’s painted homes and businesses across the Inner West — long enough to know the difference between a terrace in Balmain, a Federation home in Haberfield and a warehouse conversion in Marrickville, and to prep and coat each one accordingly.

When you call, you deal with the person who’s actually accountable for the work — the same person who quotes it, preps it and checks it at the end. That’s deliberate. It’s how the finish stays consistent and how nothing gets lost between a salesperson and a subcontractor.

props.label: How we work — every job, no exceptions
props.html:
What we stand for

How we work — every job, no exceptions

  • Prep before paint. We wash, fill, sand, caulk and prime properly — the part that decides whether a finish lasts years or months.
  • Fixed-price quotes. A clear, itemised price after an on-site look. No call-out fee, no vague estimates, no surprises on invoice day.
  • Tidy, respectful crews. Furniture protected, floors covered, site cleaned every day. We treat your home like it’s ours.
  • Premium paint systems. Leading Australian products matched to each surface and exposure — not whatever’s cheapest.
  • Local knowledge. Period homes, heritage overlays, tight terraces and strata access — we know the Inner West’s quirks.
  • Straight answers. Honest advice on what needs doing and what doesn’t, so you spend where it counts.
